serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
You: Yes I have the money.
Landlord: W-What?! Really?! Already?!
You: Is there a problem?
#Landlord.Face.Normal
Landlord: N-No, of course not! G-Give it to me and I will start working on getting us out of here.
You: Sure. 
#Landlord.Face.unhappy
You: You won’t scam us, right?
Landlord: Of course not! Who do you take me for?! Besides, what scammer would admit to the scam?! Use your brain a little!
